description: This file defines a serializer class 'DateOnlyCodec' for serializing and deserializing the 'DateOnly' struct in the Orleans.Serialization framework, specifically for .NET 6.0 or greater. It includes methods for writing and reading 'DateOnly' values to and from a wire protocol, utilizing fixed 32-bit integer representation of the date.

classes.name: DateOnlyCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for serializing and deserializing DateOnly values in Orleans serialization.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a DateOnly value into the buffer with a specified field ID delta.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a DateOnly value from the reader, given a field.
